information: The 2nd round of 3x3 cube is a head-to-head group match, where the top 24 competitors in the 1st round enter are divided into four groups. Top 2 competitors scoring the most point in each group are qualified for the 3rd round of 3x3, which is an unofficial round as the single-elimination tournament consisting of 8 competitors.
